Definition: from σῆμα (a mark; of uncertain derivation); to indicate:--signify.
BiblicalUsage: Semaino is signifying, showing plainly what is meant. Agabus stood up and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world, which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar. And Festus knew the other side of it: it seemeth unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that signifying is the duty of both prophet and judge — the prophet signs what God will do, and the judge signs what a man is charged with.
